author: Kusha N M
raw:
ವೇದಗಳ ಜ್ಞಾನಗಳ ಅರಿವುದಕೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ
ನಾದಗಳ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲನಕಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮೂಲ
ಮೋದದಲಿ ತಥ್ಯಗಳ ಬೆದಕುತಲೆ ಅರುಹುತಿರೆ
ಊದಿ ವಿಷಯವ ತೆಗೆವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To know the wisdom of the Vedas, one must study;
to give their sounds back true, practice is the root;
and when someone searches out their truths with joy and shares them,
you would blow it all away with a puff, O deluded one.
en.note: Kusha’s first Mūḍha Manuja verse, written on 18 November 2025 in the middle of a conversation about Sri Hari’s mantra posts.
en.bhavartha: Knowing the Veda takes study, and giving its sounds back faithfully takes practice. When someone does that work with joy and shares what they find, only a fool would wave it away.
